transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because… I’ve been feeling like I’ve failed. As a father, mostly, and just as a useful person. It keeps going around in my head, and I can’t seem to shake it. Sometimes it feels like I don’t really deserve much of a future.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month, I think. Since my daughter left for college out of state.
Have you been enjoying things you normally like to do over the past month?

Not really. I used to look forward to working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. Lately the trains are just sitting there half-built… and even turning on a game feels kind of pointless.
Have you experienced any pleasure in activities over the past month?

Not much, no. I used to really look forward to the railway stuff, and Cubs games with my daughter… but now the trains are just sitting there half-finished, and even putting a game on feels kind of pointless.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live or harming yourself?

Yeah… I guess I have. Not so much harming myself exactly, but I’ve had thoughts like… maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up.

And, uh… it scared me a little when I caught myself going through my finances like I was getting things ready for someone else.
Have you experienced significant weight loss or gain over the past month?
Yeah… I think I’ve lost some. I haven’t really been making proper meals. Most days I just forget to eat until late, then it’s toast or cereal or something. Had to tighten my belt a bit.
Have you been feeling restless or sluggish, or have you noticed any changes in your movement or activity level lately?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to that. Maybe I’m just doing less, but I’m not sure about being restless or moving differently.
Have you felt like you're moving more slowly than usual lately?
I’m not sure. I mean… I feel slowed down, but I don’t know if I’m actually moving slower. I haven’t really noticed.
Do you feel like you're doing less than you used to because you don't want to, or because you just can't seem to get started or get moving?
It’s more that I can’t get started. Even small things… like taking laundry upstairs or sorting the mail, it feels like I’m moving through wet cement. Doesn’t really matter how much I’ve been in bed.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?

Not really. I used to look forward to working on my model railway, or watching Cubs games with my daughter… but now the trains are just sitting there half-built. Even turning on a game feels kind of pointless.
Was there something specific that happened around the time you started feeling this way, like a big change or loss in your life?
Yeah… I guess it started about a month ago. Around when my daughter left for college out of state. I don’t know if that’s the reason, but… that’s when it seemed to begin.
Have you ever felt this low or worse before in your life?
I… I’m not sure. I’ve had rough patches before, I guess, but I don’t really know if it was like this.
Have you felt little to no pleasure in most activities for most of the past month?
Yeah… most things, I guess. The model railway’s just been sitting there half-built, and even putting on a Cubs game feels… pointless.
Have you felt little to no pleasure in most activities for most of each day over the past month?

Yeah… most of the day, I think. I used to look forward to working on the railway, or watching Cubs games with my daughter, but now the trains just sit there half-built. Even turning a game on feels kind of pointless.
Have you had periods of feeling this low or worse before in your life?
I don’t really know. I’ve had bad stretches, but… I can’t say if they were this low.
Have you had any episodes like this before in your life?
I’m not sure. I’ve had rough times before, but I don’t really know if they were… like this.
Have you had an episode like this before in your life that lasted for a while and then got better?
I don’t know. I mean, I’ve had hard times that eased up eventually, but I can’t really tell if they were the same as this.
